prompts.name: 苔石拱桥
prompts.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer.
Asset type: ONE independent architectural/landscape decoration cutout for a painterly underwater forest aquarium theme.
Input image 1 is the retained approved cottage edit target / paint reference. REDESIGN THE ENTIRE OBJECT into the distinctly different subject specified below. Preserve ONLY its hand-painted rendering language, aged chestnut root wood, weathered gray-green stone, sage/olive moss, tiny lavender bell flowers where appropriate, quiet warm amber accent and green-filtered upper-left illumination.
The user specifically rejected a collection of similar moss-roof houses. This new object MUST NOT be another cottage, room, gazebo, covered shelter or tower with a little roof. No house door, house window, wide sweeping canopy roof, tiny shop, duplicate building or token miniature cottage attached.
Use refined hand-painted Japanese fantasy environment-art textures, subtle desaturated contour lines, organic forms and clear large silhouette. Match the reference's mild frontal/right-side perspective for placement on an aquarium floor. No plastic 3D, photorealistic render, isometric city asset, bright gold palace or candy colors.
Actual RGBA transparency outside the object and through open gaps. Remove all reference backdrop RGB matte, olive haze and vignette. No landscape rectangle, river/water sheet, soil island/pedestal, cast-shadow layer, text, symbols, interface, fish, animals, people or extra objects. Complete silhouette with every tip and foot inside the canvas, at least 8% transparent margin on all sides and 10% under feet. Only the compact requested connected structure; it will be separately owned and placed.

Requested subject: a LOW UNCOVERED ARCHED FOOTBRIDGE, approximately twice as wide as tall. Make a single gentle arch built from chunky worn gray-green stone blocks with a thin moss edge, a modest root-wood handrail on either side and short stone steps at both ends. The broad arch gap underneath must be genuinely transparent, NOT filled with dark paint, water, soil or a riverbank. The stone deck itself is solid. An elegant irregular natural profile, restrained vines and a few tiny lavender flowers near one end. NO roof, door, house, pavilion or hanging lamp. No surrounding stream. The bridge is a movable aquarium decoration, not a fixed landscape illustration.

Requested subject: an OPEN FREESTANDING ROOT ARCH GATEWAY, taller than wide. Two weathered root trunks twist upward from small gray-green stone feet and meet as one thin irregular arch. This is the entrance marker of a woodland trail, NOT a shelter or pavilion: no roof plane, no broad moss canopy, no walls, door, bench or room. Thin vines and a sparse cascade of lavender bells decorate one side. The whole central passage must be truly transparent; a large clear arch-shaped negative space is its defining silhouette. A tiny warm amber seed-like inset in one stone foot is enough, no hanging lamp. The arch should look grown and worn rather than polished carved gold.

The branch bends outward near the top and holds ONE suspended amber seedpod lantern, clearly separated from the stone shaft by transparent air/water.
